editorial.blurb: Teranga brings the warmth and flavors of Senegal to your table, with an owner who treats every first-timer like family.
editorial.insiderTip: First time with Senegalese food? Tell the owner you're adventurous and willing to be surprised—he'll curate a spread of appetizers and mains across different proteins that showcase the cuisine beautifully.
